description.value: The Stagecoach Inn is a 52-room motel in Chetwynd, BC, offering fully renovated rooms with drive-up access, fridges, microwaves, and kitchenette options — a practical setup for cyclists hauling loaded bikes. An on-site restaurant and laundry facilities add to its appeal as an overnight stop. Chetwynd sits along the Hart Highway corridor, positioning this motel as a natural resupply and rest point for touring cyclists moving through northern BC.

address.value: 5413 South Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0
